verdict.rationale: Galileo captures real-time session, trace and span data, supports custom eval metrics, and lets users view session-level metrics and alert on cost and hallucination rates. That implies cost and eval-score metrics are tracked and surfaced, but nothing in the pack shows a user building custom dashboards. Missing for 10: any documentation of custom dashboard creation or configurable charts, explicit latency and error-rate panels, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
